patch.value: Implement and certify the first local release of pm-reduce.
Six CLI and SDK operations share strict schemas; exact journal and replay; qualified certificates; native guarded writes; public reproduction evidence; full release gates.

value.text: Capacity evidence for PRRT_kwDOVlPkts62C9TV: each complete request/observation pair requires 16 SHA-256 values (2 in request, 8 in observation including source references, and 3 in each of 2 replay receipts): 1024 bytes before keys. Request digest-key framing alone adds 37 bytes per pair. Thus even a strict lower bound for 254 pairs is 269494 bytes, above 262144, ignoring all remaining keys, IDs, other fields and the creation receipt. The live trial-255/511-receipt scenario is impossible at unchanged thresholds. The new fixture independently checks 254 requests, 254 observations and 509 receipts parse structurally but readState refuses capacity_exceeded. The declaration test accurately proves limit 255 admission and limit 256 refusal.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Lower-bound arithmetic clarification: the exact canonical two-key request skeleton is 39 bytes, so the stronger bound is 254 * (1024 + 39) = 270002 bytes. The prior 37-byte framing estimate was conservative; either bound already exceeds the unchanged 262144-byte policy. PM-linked focused suite passed 30/30 with no failures, skips or timeouts.
